يلهاج (form XI)
# يَلْهَاجُّ (yalhājju) /jal.haːd͡ʒ.d͡ʒu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِلْهَاجَّ (ilhājja)
# يَلْهَاجَّ (yalhājja) /jal.haːd͡ʒ.d͡ʒa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْهَاجَّ (ilhājja)
# يَلْهَاجِّ (yalhājji) /jal.haːd͡ʒ.d͡ʒi/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِلْهَاجَّ (ilhājja)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
